entries.hades2.diagnostics.explanation: Checks developer tools, protocol versions, game installation/process, the Lua connection and the runtime revision. The bundle contains state, check results, symbols.json and the tail of trainer.log only — never saves or custom profiles.

entries.hades2.gathering.title: {term:productTerms.gatheringPanel}
entries.hades2.gathering.explanation: Applies to eligible gathering trials in newly created rooms. Flora uses each native trial, without a room-wide guarantee. 0% blocks ordinary trials while preserving native forced spawns; 100% still respects eligibility, biome limits and family arbitration.
entries.hades2.gathering.generateHelp: Generate does not change probabilities or unlock/equip tools. Each family can generate one usable native gathering point per room; existing or used points cannot be restored. Hand-collected Flora does not require a fifth tool.
entries.hades2.gathering.unavailable.scene: Requires an actionable room in the current run.

entries.hades2.gathering.unavailable.lava: The current lava state prevents fishing.
entries.hades2.gathering.unavailable.existing: This family already appeared, was used or was generated; it cannot be generated again.
entries.hades2.gathering.unavailable.placement: The room has no unused native gathering placement.
entries.hades2.gathering.unavailable.pool: There are no eligible native gathering resources.
entries.hades2.gathering.unavailable.stale: Refresh the current room before generating a gathering point.
entries.hades2.gathering.collection.flora: Collect by hand or linked Familiar; no tool unlock required.
entries.hades2.gathering.unavailable.polymorph: The current polymorph state prevents native collection.
entries.hades2.chaosGate.title: {term:officialTerms.chaosGate}
entries.hades2.chaosGate.explanation: Controls the conditional occurrence chance for newly created rooms. 100% still requires native room, biome, progression and spacing eligibility; 0% suppresses uncommitted occurrence, including an unconsumed native force effect. Prepared rooms retain their captured roll, and committed entrances remain intact.
entries.hades2.chaosGate.lifecycle: Control requires an authored native point, an eligible Chaos destination and a valid return path. Entry retains native Life costs and conditions; insufficient Life blocks entry. Restoring Native / Default restores future generation without rerolling cached rooms or creating a current-room entrance.

entries.hades2.saveEditor.coldApplyNotice: Browse and stage changes while Hades II is running. Apply requires the game to be stopped; the current on-disk save is preserved as a recovery snapshot before replacement.

entries.hades2.saveEditor.coverage.title: Current Save Editor coverage
entries.hades2.saveEditor.coverage.reason.verifi: The current build has explicit semantic descriptors and verified write owners for this area.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.coverage.reason.player: Only a bounded set of player-history scalars is modeled; complete run and lifetime history remains follow-up work.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.coverage.reason.narrat: Dialogue investigation is source-backed; quest/NPC lifecycle understanding and editing are still incomplete.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.coverage.reason.relati: Interaction counters are supported; gift and relationship lifecycle editing remains deliberately read-only where ownership is incomplete.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.coverage.reason.progre: Selected quest, Arcana and objective state is modeled; broader permanent progression remains incomplete.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.coverage.reason.equipm: Selected weapons, aspects, tools and Familiar state is modeled; full progression workflow remains incomplete.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.coverage.reason.unknow: Unknown data is searchable and preserved, but never receives generic write authority.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.discovery.reason.rewar: The quest reward was already claimed; rolling back only the status would leave granted rewards and linked records inconsistent.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.discovery.reason.start: The starter weapon is native baseline ownership and cannot be revoked as an independent unlock.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.discovery.reason.baseW: The base weapon must be owned before its default aspect progression can be edited safely.
entries.hades2.saveEditor.discovery.reason.giftH: Gift counts are linked to gift order, dialogue and outcome history and cannot be edited safely as standalone counters.
